independence_rule: No simulator boot or terrain seed appears in both train and test. Inference and permutation statistics use one aggregate prediction per boot.

primary_gate.pass_rule: roughness 3-class whole-boot balanced accuracy >=0.70 under both seed-exclusive and seed+wave-exclusive protocols, and complete-enumeration terrain-label permutation p<0.05 for the double holdout; every roughness class recall >=0.60; scientific features outperform the phase-only negative control by >=0.20 balanced-accuracy points

exact_test_label_permutation.unit: whole held-out boot; labels permuted once per terrain identity
